opening.argument: The walkthrough presents StrongBlock nodes as passive income while directing viewers through Coinbase, Tether, KuCoin, STRONG, MetaMask, and node creation. It says viewers need roughly $4,400 or more upfront, then must continue paying $14.95 every 30 days or the node will be nulled. Against those costs, the speaker reports about $1,200 monthly from one node, projects about $2,400 from a second, and says an $8,000-$9,000 outlay would be paid off in around four months. The speaker does advise viewers to read the terms and do their research, but those qualifications do not remove the direct promotional link between the required purchases, recurring fees, and claimed returns.
